description: This file implements the core synchronization logic for the Notesnook application, including connection management, data fetching, data sending, and processing sync chunks. It defines classes SyncManager and Sync, handles SignalR connection setup, and manages sync-related events and data migrations.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: Manages overall synchronization process, including starting, stopping, and acquiring locks for sync operations.

classes.name: Sync
classes.description: Handles detailed synchronization logic such as establishing SignalR connections, fetching and sending data, processing chunks, and managing sync state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the sync process based on provided options, including fetching and sending data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the device for sync, registering if necessary.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches data from the server, handling conflicts and offline attachments.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Uploads local changes to the server, including attachments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the sync process, optionally re-syncing if there are unsynced changes.

methods.name: uploadAttachments
methods.description: Queues attachments for upload during sync.

methods.name: processChunk
methods.description: Processes incoming data chunks, decrypts, deserializes, and merges items.

methods.name: pushItem
methods.description: Pushes a sync item to the server.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Establishes a SignalR connection for real-time sync.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves the user's encryption key for decrypting incoming data.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Ensures the SignalR connection is active, with timeout handling.
